Smoother everywhere, a new sign-in page and an author credit.

### Smoother

Measured in Chrome at 4× CPU slowdown on a 1840×1040 @125 % screen, against 1.0.1:

| Interaction | Style recalculation | Paint + raster | Long frames |
|---|---|---|---|
| Switching light / dark | 488 → 100 ms | 261 → 32 ms | 67 % → 6 % |
| Hovering down the menu | 53 → 13 ms | 86 → 28 ms | — |
| Hovering the collapsed rail | 200 → 117 ms | 212 → 114 ms | — |

- Menu highlights are instant (no colour fade trailing the pointer)
- The top bar is opaque: its backdrop blur re-rendered the page under it on every scroll frame
- Light/dark and accent changes restyle the page once, with transitions off, instead of fading hundreds of elements
- Dashboard widgets snap into place while loading; later they only slide when you rearrange them, never resize-animate
- Shorter, eased menu-section, dialog and dropdown animations that move only transform/opacity
- Network Map: tiles keep the same height while devices start and stop sending, refreshes only rewrite what changed, and a small dot flashes when live traffic updates
- CSS is now compressed (235 → 200 KiB) and an expensive `:has()` selector is gone
- Respects the operating system's *reduce motion* setting

### Sign-in page

- Clean card with the UniSense app icon and the host you are signing in to
- Show/hide password button and a Caps Lock warning
- Busy spinner on the button while signing in

### Also

- "Author Ox1d3x3 × UniSense v1.0.2" in the bottom-right corner of every page and the sign-in page
- The fixed footer no longer runs past the right edge of the window

### Update

```sh
fetch -o - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ox1d3x3/unisense/main/install.sh | sh
```
